record_id.rationale: The grain is licence number x licence class. Licence Number alone would collide, since one licence spans many class rows. Licence Grade is added because a class name such as 'Builder - Open' appears under both Builder Licence and Site Supervisor. The 'id' column is a sequential row number that is unlikely to be stable across publications, so it is not used. The holdout of 500 rows showed 0 duplicate keys, but uniqueness over the full file is unverified, and a reviewer should check it.

mappings.rationale: Licensee name on a regulator register. For company rows (about 36%, with a Pty Ltd/Ltd suffix and an ACN) it is the registered name. For Individual rows it is the person's own name, likely matching their ABN entity name but not a registered business name. Confidence is lowered because the column mixes both.
Company is set only from unambiguous legal suffixes, otherwise unknown. 'Individual' is deliberately not mapped to sole_trader, because the licence type does not establish that.
Space-formatted ('636 110 962'). The acn op strips the spaces and checks the checksum (about 99.4% valid in the holdout). Blank for non-companies.
Space-formatted ('75 158 361 912'). The abn op strips the spaces and checks the checksum (about 99.7% valid in the holdout). Blank for many individuals.
Single free-text address string with irregular whitespace. Whitespace is normalised and nothing else is changed.

transforms.pattern: (?i)\b(NSW|VIC|QLD|WA|SA|TAS|ACT|NT|New South Wales|Victoria|Queensland|Western Australia|South Australia|Tasmania|Australian Capital Territory|Northern Territory)\s+\d{4}\s*$

mappings.rationale: The state, as an abbreviation or full name, sits immediately before the 4-digit postcode at the end of the string. Addresses that do not fit the pattern are dropped rather than guessed.
The trailing 4 digits of the address are the postcode (500/500 in the holdout).
Queensland regulator register. Every sampled address ends in an AU state and postcode. Not verified across the full file.

unmapped_source_fields.reason: Sequential row number, not a licensee or licence key, and probably unstable across publications. Not used in the record id.
Used in the record id. There is no canonical field for a licence identifier. It is not an ABN or ACN.

Describes the licence holder category (Company/Individual). It is not used for entity_type because Individual does not establish sole_trader. It matches the ACN and company-suffix rates and is useful as evidence only.
Financial reporting category for the licence. No canonical field.
Code for Financial Category. No canonical field.
Licence kind (Builder, Trade Contractor, Nominee Supervisor, etc.). No canonical field. It does not indicate entity status.
QBCC trade or licence class, not ANZSIC. Mapping it to industry_code would be wrong. Used only in the record id.

unmapped_canonical_fields.reason: No trading or business name column.
No status column. The dataset includes Suspended licences but excludes Cancelled ones, and they cannot be told apart, so 'active' cannot be asserted.
No ANZSIC value. Licence Class Type is a different taxonomy.
No registration or licence start date.
Locality is embedded in free text after the street with no delimiter ('45 Chetwynd St Loganholme QLD 4129'), so it cannot be split reliably with the available transforms.
No per-record date column. The engine falls back to the resource last-modified date.

source_reliability.rationale: Statutory regulator register, authoritative for licensee name, ABN/ACN and licence status. Lowered slightly because the extract is a denormalised snapshot, and the generation date and download header disagree.

notes: Grain is one row per licence x class, so a licensee appears on many rows (e.g. 19 rows for Wormald Australia Pty Ltd). Identical entity-level observations (name, ABN, ACN, address) will repeat per row. Dedupe or group on Licence Number downstream.

About 64% of rows are Individuals. legal_name is now emitted for them as the person's name (confidence 0.7), and entity_type stays 'unknown' for them. Their names and business addresses are likely personal data, and the business address may be a home address. Reviewer decision: whether to keep individual names and addresses, or restrict legal_name to company-suffix names (a regex filter was tried and rejected because it produces a parse error on every individual row).
Individual rows without an ABN have no identifier beyond the licence number, so linking them to entities will be weak. Downstream linking should not rely on name alone.
Licence is CC-BY-4.0 per the dataset metadata, so no licence flag is needed.

Date discrepancy for a reviewer to reconcile: metadata_modified is 2026-09-23, the resource says current as at 23/09/2026, and the download header says 30 Oct 2026. observed_at will fall back to the resource last-modified date.
Suspended licensees are included and cannot be distinguished, so status is deliberately unmapped.
The address.state regex uses the inline (?i) flag and assumes Python-style regex semantics in the engine. If the engine does not support it, state values will be dropped.
The state mapping accepts abbreviations and full names. Addresses ending in neither (about 0 in the holdout after this fix) are dropped.
Only the first 5000 records were profiled, and 500 held-out records were checked. Encoding is assumed to be UTF-8 and was not verified beyond the sample. The file is about 37 MB.
Name casing is inconsistent (upper-case, mixed-case) and is preserved as-is. A few ABN/ACN values fail the checksum (<1%) and are dropped rather than emitted.
